answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on positional fine-grained citation generation for long-form QA.

answer_2.quote: We propose a new evaluation method, ALiiCE, Automatic LLM's Positional Fine-grained Citation Evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three annotators to evaluate the outputs of the models used in the previous experiments.
answer_4.guideline: We focus on five metrics: PF Sample, Answer Utility, PF Citation Utility, Citation Recall, Citation Precision.
